description: Phase 1 performance budgets for the Architech public prototype. Re-baselined 18 Sep 2026 after the TechnoProperty mobile workspace added authenticated drawer and bottom navigation, persisted card/table inventory views, and accessible optimistic action workflows across the broker routes: total static JS measured 2248.6 KiB and the aggregate cap moved to 2.24 MiB with 2.1% headroom. Individual route and gzip caps remain unchanged because every route still passes them. Prior re-baselines: 26 Aug 2026 locality intelligence (2.16 MiB total) and 25 Aug 2026 parity overlay (2.15 MiB total).

/search.why: /search ships the map and filter stack, so it is the heaviest route and already exceeded the 770000 default before this branch (758.8 KiB at c35247f). Update: the arena branch grew it ~14.3 KiB raw (759.6 KiB at c17c155 → 773.9 KiB at 4f7a308) via palette filter actions, Hindi search copy, and bbox/facet wiring — shipped features measured in the bundle, not drift. Ceiling raised to 820000 raw to admit that work with a hard guard margin; gzip stays 245000 (multiplied content compresses better than the raw line suggests). Re-ratchet 6 Sep 2026 (performance-audit finding F2): measured build on 2a447df merged with origin/main b08c481 ships /search at 737.9 KiB raw / 228.4 KiB gzip — ~36 KiB below the 4f7a308 reading after MapLibre vendoring and router churn settled. Ceiling lowered 820000 → 780000 to restore regression sensitivity (~5.7% raw guard margin); gzip budget unchanged at 245000. The ratchet rule is unchanged: this line moves only with a measured before/after in the why.
